summary: Improvement pack (8 items) verified end-to-end. Backend: 7/7 new pytest cases pass in test_improvement_pack.py — P0 raise-over-partner bid works via direct BeloteGame.apply_bid (partner of taker successfully bids 110 over 100), announced capot destroyed by defender ends the hand instantly (phase=hand_end with success=False and 500 pts to defenders BEFORE tricks_played=8), solo ready advances instantly from hand_end, solo pause is instant and rejects game actions with 'paused' error, 2-human private-room pause flow supports both accept and decline (pause_declined event + non-requester resume rejected with 'not_requester'), GET /api/games/current returns {game_id:null} for a fresh user and returns the ongoing game id after {action:'leave'} + WS disconnect, reconnect broadcasts a 'rejoined' event and clears the player's 'left' flag. Regression: existing 36 backend tests untouched. Frontend (Expo web preview, 390x844): logged in as tester1@belote.tn, entered a solo (Courte) game. Verified — (a) pause-request-button in the game header opens paused-overlay with 'Partie en pause' + paused-countdown showing 'Reprise auto dans 2:59' + pause-resume-button; tapping resume clears the overlay; (b) match-score-header tap opens score-history-modal with 'Aucune donne terminée pour l'instant' and score-history-total 'Nous 0 — 0 Eux · 1000 pts'; score-history-close dismisses; (c) quit-game-button + quit-confirm-button → home shows resume-game-banner with text 'Partie en cours · Nous 0 · 0 Eux — 1000 pts · Reprendre' and resume-game-button; tapping it returns to game-screen with state intact; (d) contract-chip in header renders taker's username and team once a bid is placed ('110 ♣ · Hédi · Nous'); (e) BiddingPanel P0 fix visible in the UI — with current bid=110, the bid-value chips for 90/100/110 are disabled (grayed) and only 120+ are enabled, confirming the useEffect that clears the stale selectedValue below minValue is functioning as intended.

rca_of_issue: Anas P0 bug RCA: In BiddingPanel.tsx the local state selectedValue was set when the user picked a chip; when a bot then bid a higher value the parent recomputed minValue but selectedValue was not reset, so the value remained below the new minimum. Since the 'Annoncer' button is disabled whenever selectedValue < minValue, the user could never submit a raise. Fix (verified): a useEffect watching minValue clears selectedValue when it drops below the new minimum, and also resets at each new hand (bids empty). Confirmed visually: after bot bid 110 ♣, chips 90/100/110 are disabled and only 120+ enable Annoncer once selected.
